edits.value_json: 火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. 字源 tentatively says the oracle-bone use may refer to 火星, without specifying 心宿二 or the planet Mars. The CUHK 火 and 晶 entries explain 火星 in this context as the historical short name for 大火, or 心宿二 (Antares). The sources do not establish why the star was called 火 or a semantic connection with literal ‘fire’.
